regime.label: Stagflationary hawkish hold
regime.oneLiner: A hawkish-Fed repricing dominates — higher-for-longer rates (10Y 4.50%) and a fresh semis wobble — but thawing sentiment and healthy breadth cushion the tape into today's FOMC minutes and the 14 July CPI.

topNews.headline: Silver holds ~$61/oz after a ~6% weekly rebound; Silver Institute pegs a widening 46.3Moz 2026 deficit
topNews.actionable: Core levered-silver thesis working again — hold, but size leverage so a retest of ~$58 cannot force liquidation ahead of the 14 July CPI.

topNews.headline: June FOMC minutes land today (US); July hold priced ~73%, a hike by December still ~two-thirds
topNews.actionable: Mark today (minutes) and 14 July (CPI) as the two hawkish-risk dates for the silver stack — keep option/stop protection on through the CPI print.

topNews.headline: June payrolls miss at +57K with -74K revisions; near-term Fed hike odds crumble
topNews.actionable: The most metal-friendly data point of the window — it directly reduces the hike-repricing risk that crushed silver in June, arguing for holding rather than de-risking into the bounce.

topNews.headline: China formalizes rare-earth export enforcement (MOFCOM mechanism live 1 July); MP & USA Rare Earth stay on the control list
topNews.actionable: Tighter Chinese enforcement raises the scarcity premium on ex-China supply — treat pullbacks in MP/LYC.AX/UUUU as watchlist scale-in candidates funded from cash.

topNews.headline: Tencent's near-daily buyback continues into July (HK$204.8m on 6 July after ~HK$500m June tranches)
topNews.actionable: Hold 0700.HK; the persistent buyback bid supports HK$450-460 — add on dips into that zone rather than chasing rallies.
